info.title: API.SH: GOG
info.description: The GOG API from API.SH: public GOG data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A GOG game, DLC or pack: price and rating, description and overview, developers, publishers, tags, features, languages (text/audio), system requirements per OS, age ratings (ESRB, PEGI, USK...), editions, bonus content, videos, screenshots, images, DLCs, related products, installer and patch sizes, changelog, forum and support links, release dates and sale status.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/gog-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: GOG product id (`1207658924`), slug (`the_witcher`) or a gog.com/game link.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency code for prices (e.g. USD, EUR); the country's own by default.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language of texts, e.g. en-US (default), de-DE, fr-FR, pl-PL.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
User reviews of a GOG product: title, text, rating (1-5), date, helpful votes, language and reviewer name; review and rating counts, average and filtered average rating, the most helpful review. Sort and language filter as on the site. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/gog-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: GOG product id, slug or link.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Review languages, comma separated (e.g. en-US,de-DE); all by default.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
GOG store catalog with every store filter and sort: query, product type, genres, tags, features, languages, operating systems, developers, publishers, price range, release years, discounted, release status, excluded tags; prices for any country and currency. Each product: id, slug, title, price (final, base, discount), rating, review count, developers, publishers, systems, genres, tags, features, editions, age ratings, covers and screenshots. Also returns the filter values the store offers. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/gog-search

parameters.name: product_type
parameters.description: Comma separated: game, pack, dlc, extras (default all).

parameters.name: genres
parameters.description: Comma separated genre slugs (e.g. rpg,strategy); see `available_filters`.

parameters.name: exclude_tags
parameters.description: Comma separated tag slugs to leave out.

parameters.name: developers
parameters.description: Comma separated developer names as GOG lists them.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency code for prices (e.g. USD, EUR); the country's own by default.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language of texts, e.g. en-US (default), de-DE, fr-FR, pl-PL.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
